### Borea v0.6.29

Update with "Update now" on the Home banner or run `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Improved

- Simplified Chinese now covers the Versions tab hint when the Show filter hides every release. Thank you, @kuxiaowo!
- Steward tools: when you already have an open status pull request, a second Delist, Dispute, Retract or Lift goes onto that pull request. Before, each change opened its own pull request, and the later ones conflicted once the first one merged.

#### Fixed

- In the listing editor, a late download progress update no longer replaces the result of reading a release archive.

[Full changelog for v0.6.28 to v0.6.29](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.28...v0.6.29)
